permissions.name: Accessibility Access
permissions.what_it_does: Allows an application to read on-screen text, detect interface changes, and perform taps or navigation actions on your behalf.
legitimate_uses: Screen readers and voice assistants for users with visual or motor impairments
Trusted password-manager autofill helpers and assistive automation tools
potential_abuse: Silently reading OTPs, banking balances, and private messages displayed on screen
Performing hidden clicks, approving transfers, or preventing you from uninstalling the app
precautions: Only enable Accessibility for well-known assistive apps you intentionally installed from an official store.
Never grant Accessibility access because a caller, support agent, or prize link asked you to.
permissions.android_settings_path: Settings -> Accessibility -> Downloaded apps / Installed services -> Select the app -> Turn off if unneeded (labels vary slightly by phone brand).

permissions.name: Notification Access
permissions.what_it_does: Permits an application to read, dismiss, or trigger actions from notifications posted by other apps.
legitimate_uses: Smartwatch and fitness-band companion apps displaying alerts on your wrist
potential_abuse: Capturing bank SMS alerts, UPI payment notifications, and login OTPs as soon as they arrive
Dismissing genuine bank fraud warnings before you notice them
precautions: Regularly check which apps can read your notifications and disable any unfamiliar entries.
A calculator, wallpaper, flashlight, or PDF viewer has no legitimate reason to read all notifications.
permissions.android_settings_path: Settings -> Apps -> Special app access -> Notification read, reply & control / Notification access -> Toggle off unfamiliar apps.

permissions.name: Display Over Other Apps (Overlay)
permissions.what_it_does: Lets an application draw floating windows, buttons, or full-screen layers on top of other running apps.
legitimate_uses: Floating chat bubbles, video picture-in-picture windows, and call-ID popups
Blue-light filters, floating timers, and screen-recording toolbars
potential_abuse: Drawing fake banking login screens on top of real apps to capture credentials
Hiding system permission prompts ('tapjacking') so you unknowingly approve sensitive settings
precautions: Review overlay permissions for newly installed or seldom-used apps.
Close unexpected floating popups before entering any PIN, password, or OTP.
permissions.android_settings_path: Settings -> Apps -> Special app access -> Display over other apps -> Disable for apps that do not need floating windows.

permissions.name: Install Unknown Apps
permissions.what_it_does: Allows a browser, file manager, or messaging app to install Android application packages (.apk files) from outside an official app store.
legitimate_uses: Installing vetted enterprise software provided by an employer's IT department
Testing apps you developed yourself during software development
potential_abuse: Installing disguised malicious APKs sent over WhatsApp or SMS as fake 'e-challan', 'courier update', or 'bank KYC' apps
precautions: Keep 'Install unknown apps' set to Not Allowed for WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS apps, and web browsers.
Never install an APK file sent by an unknown contact, customer-care caller, or urgent delivery link.
permissions.android_settings_path: Settings -> Apps -> Special app access -> Install unknown apps -> Set browsers, messaging apps, and file managers to Not allowed.
